text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Convergent and divergent genes expression

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: profiles associated with brain-wide functional

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: connectome dysfunction in deficit and non-deficit

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: schizophrenia

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Deficit schizophrenia (DS) is a subtype

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: of schizophrenia characterized by the primary and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: persistent negative symptoms. Previous studies have

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: identified differences in brain functions between DS and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: non-deficit schizophrenia (NDS) patients. However, the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: genetic regulation features underlying these abnormal

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: changes are still unknown. This study aimed to detect

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: the altered patterns of functional connectivity (FC) in DS

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and NDS and investigate the gene expression profiles

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: underlying these abnormal FC. The study recruited 82

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: DS patients, 96 NDS patients, and 124 healthy controls

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: (CN). Voxel-based unbiased brain-wide association study

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: was performed to reveal altered patterns of FC in DS and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: NDS patients. Machine learning techniques were used to

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: access the utility of altered FC for diseases diagnosis.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA)

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: was employed to explore the associations between

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: altered FC and gene expression of 6 donated brains.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Enrichment analysis was conducted to identify the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: genetic profiles, and the spatio-temporal expression

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: patterns of the key genes were further explored.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Comparing to CN, 23 and 20 brain regions with altered

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: FC were identified in DS and NDS patients. The altered

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: FC among these regions showed significant correlations

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: with the SDS scores and exhibited high efficiency in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: disease classification. WGCNA revealed associations

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: between DS/NDS-related gene expression and altered

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: FC. Additionally, 22 overlapped genes, including 12

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: positive regulation genes and 10 negative regulation

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: genes, were found between NDS and DS. Enrichment

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: analyses demonstrated relationships between identified

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: genes and significant pathways related to cellular

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: response, neuro regulation, receptor binding, and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: channel activity. Spatial and temporal gene expression

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: profiles of SCN1B showed the lowest expression at the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: initiation of embryonic development, while DPYSL3

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: exhibited rapid increased in the fetal. The present study

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: revealed different altered patterns of FC in DS and NDS

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: patients and highlighted the potential value of FC in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: disease classification. The associations between gene

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: expression and neuroimaging provided insights into

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: specific and common genetic regulation underlying

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: these brain functional changes in DS and NDS,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: suggesting a potential genetic-imaging pathogenesis of

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: schizophrenia.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Rapid Effects of BCI-Based Attention Training on

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Functional Brain Connectivity in Poststroke

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Patients: A Pilot Resting-State fMRI Study

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: The

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: prevalence of stroke-induced cognitive impairment is

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: high. Effective approaches to the treatment of these

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: cognitive impairments after stroke remain a serious and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: perhaps underestimated challenge. A BCI-based

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: task-focused training that results in repetitive

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: recruitment of the normal motor or cognitive circuits

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: may strengthen stroke-affected neuronal connectivity,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: leading to functional improvements. In the present

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: controlled study, we attempted to evaluate the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: modulation of neuronal circuits under the influence of 10

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: days of training in a P3-based BCI speller in subacute

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: ischemic stroke patients.
